payload.summary: CP-HARDEN-07 machine-readable owner/external wait lifecycle is implemented, CI-validated, merged, exercised through a real stale-claim reviewer recovery, and synchronized into authoritative hardening state.
payload.next_action: Release the CP-HARDEN-07 canonical-sync claim, then verify current claims/incidents and acquire a bounded CP-HARDEN-03 claim if still free. Do not broaden AIR-10 yet.
decisions: Represent WAITING_OWNER and WAITING_EXTERNAL as BLOCKED plus a machine-readable wait_state to remain backward-compatible with the canonical status validator.
A waiting lane has active_claim=null and therefore no lease heartbeat or checkpoint-watch pressure.
The waiting work_item, branch and resource locks remain reserved so another lane cannot take the same logical resource under a different work-item name.
resume_wait requires an explicit signal_id and evidence_refs and returns the lane to READY without silently auto-claiming implementation work.
Parseable malformed extension requests are quarantined fail-closed before specialized processors can abort the serialized reconcile run.
A CLAIM_LEASE_EXPIRED block may be cleared only through explicit Main/Reviewer stale-block reconciliation matching the exact canonical work_item and claim_id with evidence.
CP-HARDEN-03 and CP-HARDEN-06 remain bounded hardening work before any broad AIR-10 rollout.
